chunks.text: Been thinking about sneaking off to Chongqing soon and doing a proper food crawl, just to see what the vibe is like.
And maybe I’ll swing through Beijing around early April too, so I’ve been mulling over where I’d even stay if that happens.
If I actually end up doing the Chongqing thing, I keep coming back to Xiao Tian E Hotpot for dinner on 2026-05-15, probably around 19:00.
For that hotpot night I’d likely just do a small table — party of 2 — and I guess I’d put it under Huang Tao with 13866778899.
And for Beijing, I’m kind of considering Grand Mercure Beijing, checking in 2026-04-05 for 1 night, name would be Deng Hui… not sure if I’ll actually do this, we’ll see.
